Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our discussion, this thread is to capture a proposed rollout and the minimum items we need to start provisioning additional API keys and capacity for Avalon’s new projects. High level: you mentioned three teams (Search, Customer Support, Analytics) want dedicated API keys and a staged rollout across Q4.

I attached a short draft agenda and a RACI spreadsheet to help assign owners. Quick asks so we can move: 
- Can you confirm the exact project names and the primary owner for each team? (Search: ?, Support: ?, Analytics: ?)
- Do you want keys segregated by project or by environment (prod/stage)?
- Any procurement constraints we should know before we push an amendment (PO number timing, central procurement contact)?

Proposed technical rollout (draft):
1) Provision bulk API keys for two pilot projects (Search prod + Support prod)
2) Canary traffic routing for Search (2-week canary at 10% traffic)
3) Finalize committed capacity for Q4 (tokens/day) and price amendment
4) Full rollout and key stamping for Analytics after pilot success

If that looks good I’ll work with Ben to produce an amendment with the capacity table and Monica to prepare the bulk key issuance plan (namespaces, rate limits). Next practical step: a 30-minute call with DevOps and procurement to lock on owners and PO timing. Are you available Tue/Wed morning PST?

Thanks — attaching the agenda and RACI.
